layers.authority: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade (ICMBio)
layers.process: Jericoacoara National Park (Parque Nacional de Jericoacoara), Ceará: filming or photography for commercial use needs ICMBio's special image-capture authorisation, requested through its service page. ICMBio lists loggerhead, hawksbill and olive ridley turtles among threatened species protected in the park.

zone-requirements.note: Jericoacoara National Park only. ICMBio's visitor page (icmbio.gov.br portal) refused the fetch; entry rules and the Jijoca de Jericoacoara municipal tourism fee not yet read.

public_holidays: 2027-03-25 (Thursday): Data Magna do Ceará (end of slavery in the state, 1884), state holiday set by Emenda Constitucional 73/2011 to the state constitution
culture-cycles.note: The amendment names 25 March the state's data magna; that it is a day off for state offices is shown in Ceará municipal and Alece notices, which are not state decrees. Check the Diário Oficial do Estado for any 2027 move.

laws.heading: Lei 14.436/2009
laws.rule: Ceará state Lei 14.436/2009 bans smoking cigarettes, cigars, pipes and any other smoking product, tobacco or not, in indoor shared spaces, public or private: workplaces, schools, bars, restaurants, hospitals, shopping centres and public transport. Lei 17.760/2021 added e-cigarettes and vaporisers. Open-air areas are outside the ban, even when partly covered. A venue may keep a smoking area if it has a physical barrier and a system that vents the air outdoors.
laws.penalty_signal: venue fines of 500 UFIRCE (first), 1,000 (second), 1,500 (third), then closure for 48 hours
